As humans, we all are companions on this earthly journey, sharing in the trials and tribulations of life, and striving towards the same ultimate goal - pleasing Allah (God) and attaining eternal paradise. In this sense, every person is a "Shareekah" or partner in this spiritual quest, with each one contributing their unique gifts and experiences towards the greater good.
